summary: This is an 8-K reporting an at-the-market (ATM) equity program. Chaince Digital Holdings entered a Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright to sell up to $300 million of its ordinary shares over time at prevailing market prices. The agent receives a 3.0% cash commission. There is no fixed price, premium, or close date; the company is not obligated to sell shares. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation, and no transaction terms are disclosed beyond the maximum offering amount and commission rate. Watch for future sales notices and potential dilution to existing shareholders.
